sections.title: Welcome
sections.content: After DFV, it can be hard to trust again. This lesson explores what healthy relationships look like.

sections.title: Core Concepts
sections.content: Healthy relationships include respect, communication, boundaries, and equality.

sections.title: Practical Skills
sections.content: Parents learn to identify red flags and green flags in future relationships.

sections.title: Activity
sections.content: List qualities you want in future relationships.

sections.title: Reflection
sections.content: You deserve relationships that are safe, respectful, and supportive.
